name: The Ensorcelled Parchment
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
This parchment is enchanted with a spell, rendering it indecipherable.  But one word at the top of the paper can be read:

      Nagaz
narrative.objectives: Take the Ensorcelled Parchment to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.
narrative.offerRewardText:
More encrypted notes?

I wish I had the talents to decrypt all the strange bits of writing that trickle down from Alterac. But I'm afraid I lack the knowledge.
narrative.requestItemsText: Oh. You have something you'd like me to look at? Some scrap of lore gathered from up in the mountains, I hope...
